text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Olive oil, and these herbs...
Yeah, with this recipe...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's still not right... Why can't I
recreate the flavor from that restaurant?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should reduce the black pepper.
Or try adding more
balsamic vinegar, perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, could it be the garlic...!?
Yeah, let's give it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista was so particular about her dressing
that she kept remaking it over and over, exhausting herself in the process...
